mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a custom built-in grill station?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom built-in grill station installation can vary significantly based on complexity, materials, and features. A basic setup might take 2-4 weeks from design finalization to completion, while more elaborate designs with extensive utilities, custom cabinetry, or unique finishes could extend to 6-10 weeks or more. Factors like weather, material lead times, and permitting also influence the schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, but typically ranges from 2-4 weeks for basic designs to 6-10 weeks for more complex grill stations, depending on features and materials.
